name: EPIC 211621689
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 6.4 solar radii and 1.37 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,008 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.37 solar masses and 6.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,001 K at its surface.
